verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI notes SaaS, but the evidence shows no user-configurable recurring schedule. Recipes are run with a single click. Pre-meeting briefs, auto-drafted follow-ups and HubSpot sync are built-in or event-triggered automations, not schedulable recurring workflows. Zapier and the API are third-party or developer building blocks, so none of these count as the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
